title: Fix the picking or the writing
statement: When a pipeline that picks among drafts fails, check whether any draft passed: if one did, fix the picking; if none did, fix how drafts are written.
example: Fixing the routing rescued 9 of 11 failures where a passing item existed and 0 of 4 where none did.
detail: Of one run's 159 failures, 114 were for objectives where a passing item already sat in the bank of past winners and 45 for objectives with none (`LAB_PIPELINE_GUIDE.md`). A fallback that fixed the routing rescued 9 of 11 of the first kind and 0 of 4 of the second. The lab's rule is that if a passing candidate exists but was not selected, fix retrieval or the selector, and if none exists, fix generation or data; elsewhere, new guards caught the previous leaks but the writer filled the gap with new failure modes, so more generic guards were judged likely to chase symptoms. More checks cannot rescue a pipeline in which no draft passes, since checks can only reject.
against: The rescue counts are small, 11 and 4 items.

evidence.quote: If a passing candidate exists but was not selected, fix retrieval/selector; if none exists, fix generation/data.
- **bank_miss = 114 rows (71.7% of all failures)**: substandard IS in parent's `unit1_live_winner_bank.json` but live still failed.
- bank_gap rescue rate **0/4 = 0%** (confirmed: parent's fallback can't help; lab mining needed)
The new guards caught the previous leaks, but the LLM filled the gap with new failure modes. More generic guard stacking is likely to chase symptoms.
